$comment: Frozen hosted OIDC route contract. deploy/azure/infra/entra/app-registration.bicep registers these paths with Entra, HB-11 must serve exactly these paths on the API, and HB-12 asserts the deployed registration against them. Changing a value here is a breaking change for all three.

callback.purpose: Authorization code + PKCE redirect target. Must equal Platform:Authentication:Oidc:Providers:0:RedirectUri byte for byte.

frontChannelLogout.purpose: Entra-initiated front-channel sign-out. Clears the __Host-vistara-session cookie and returns 200 with no body.

signedOut.purpose: post_logout_redirect_uri landing route after RP-initiated sign-out. Entra requires it to be a registered reply URL.
